text: Once upon a time, a king decided he wanted to marry the most deserving woman in the kingdom.
He told his best friend, and the news quickly spread across the land.
The king said, "I will only marry a woman who is pure of heart.
I have a magical mirror.
It will reveal the true nature of anyone who looks into it."
The barber told all his clients about the king's plan.
Now, everyone was talking about it.
The shepherd girl hears the rumor while tending sheep outside the kingdom.
